about565.heroCopy: We've built our nama through victories, adapted when challenge changed, dan kept moving forward. We're proud dari our strength, honest about our imperfections, dan here ke enjoy game together.
about565.heroSubtitle: Kompetitif secara alami. Saling menghormati karena pilihan.
about565.heroArtworkSuggestion: Suggested: state emblem, aliansi grup, atau cinematic battle banner
about565.trackRecordCopy: Our history gives us something ke be proud dari. It also reminds us itu staying strong means continuing ke adapt.
about565.battlesDescription: Opsional: add Volcano War screenshots, victory records, atau battle collage
about565.storyCopy: Power membawa kami sejauh ini. Strategi membuat kami terus berkembang.
about565.storyParagraphOne: For long time, we telah strong enough ke bulldoze our way through events. Planning wasn't always necessary when our power spoke untuk itself.
about565.storyParagraphTwo: Then other states started catching up. We had ke think differently, coordinate better, dan learn ke use our strengths lebih carefully. So we did — dan wins kept coming.
about565.storyParagraphThree: We're tidak perfectly organized, dan we don't always get things right. We simply believe itu yesterday's success should never stop us dari improving today.
about565.strategySuggestion: Suggested: Volcano War map, aliansi formations, atau planning tangkapan layar
about565.lifeSubtitle: Tenang saat sepi. Aktif saat dibutuhkan.
about565.lifeCopy: We don't need ke be online semua day ke care about our state. Real life comes first, but when event starts, our people show up.
about565.rulesCopy: A strong state needs shared expectations. These rules help us protect aktif players, respect aliansi, dan work together.
about565.napSchedule: Saturday, Sunday dan Monday · No looting within State 565, subject ke specific border-base rule below.
about565.napProtectDetail: No bases di State 565 mungkin be looted during seluruh state NAP. This applies ke everyone, including top aliansi dan their farms.
about565.napParticipationDetail: NAP protection extends ke aliansi dengan high participation. We do tidak segregate aliansi based pada power alone.
about565.napReturnDetail: On Saturday, anggota whose bases adalah outside their aliansi hive receive 48 hours ke return. Bases still outside hive setelah itu period become eligible untuk looting under ini rule, as they mungkin telah been tidak aktif untuk days.
about565.napDefenseDetail: Aliansi anggota mungkin reinforce dan defend base itu becomes eligible untuk looting. In practice, ini process adalah rarely used against aktif players. It mainly helps recover resources dari players who telah quit game, which dapat later be shared dengan state.
about565.mergersCopy: We don't force aliansi ke merge. If aliansi struggles because dari low activity, we mungkin recommend merger untuk benefit dari its anggota dan state. But every aliansi telah its own pimpinan, friendships, dan reasons untuk its decisions. We offer advice, understand itu circumstances differ, dan respect each aliansi's choices.
about565.culture: Kami bertarung untuk menang. Kami tak pernah lupa bahwa ini hanyalah game.
about565.closingCopy: We're proud dari our record, honest about what needs work, dan ready untuk next challenge. Seasons end, rankings change, dan victories become memories. The people dan experiences we share adalah what make it worthwhile.

achievements.svsDescription: The only state among 561–576 ke remain undefeated di State vs. State, according ke our record.
achievements.563Description: We faced State 563 twice dan came away victorious pada both occasions.
achievements.hardDescription: Our first Volcano War victory came di Hard Mode, facing three states di once.
achievements.twoVtwoDescription: In our second Volcano War, we fought alongside State 567 against State 571 dan dominated battle together.

principles.improveDescription: We telah once strong enough ke win through raw power alone. As others caught up, we learned ke plan, coordinate, dan fight smarter.
principles.realLifeDescription: We adalah tidak online around clock. We telah work, families, responsibilities, dan lives outside game. When events begin, we show up.
principles.banterDescription: We joke, tease, dan compete. But there adalah difference between having fun dan making someone feel unwelcome. We believe itu difference matters.
principles.peopleDescription: We want ke win, but never di cost dari community. No event atau ranking adalah worth making people miserable di game meant ke be enjoyed.
